tagline: Champion of transparency, opportunity and sustainable growth in markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue from data and analytics subscriptions is the structural pillar of SPGI's growth and profitability, with strong visibility and high margins, characteristic of SaaS champions in the tech sector.

kpis.name: Recurring subscription revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by data subscription contracts, benchmarks and analytics.
kpis.description: SPGI derives more than 90% of its revenues from recurring models via subscriptions, notably in Ratings, Market Intelligence and Indices.
kpis.signal: +8% annual recurring revenue growth: strong signal of customer loyalty and visibility.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Strong margin reflects the efficiency of the fixed-cost model and the scalable nature of digital products.
kpis.signal: Operating margin close to 50%: exceptional level for a data and analytics company.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin after cost of services delivered.
kpis.description: High gross margin is supported by the low material intensity of data and analytics activities.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of a software and data provider.

kpis.name: R&D investments (as share of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development spending relative to revenue.
kpis.description: SPGI invests in improving existing products, notably through generative AI in analytical workflows.
kpis.signal: Stable but moderate R&D: priority on integration and applied AI rather than radical innovation.

kpis.name: Employee count
kpis.description: Headcount growth supports AI product development and geographic expansion.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount increase despite sector-wide rationalization trends.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to maintain and develop operations.
kpis.description: Investments target cloud infrastructure, security and AI integration.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to strengthen technology platforms and cybersecurity.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 61.2 billion € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 13.58 billion € in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.97 $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 1.17 billion $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 26.2% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 6.063 billion $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income annually, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Net income of 4.471 billion $ in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cumulative AI API calls
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to generative AI APIs integrated in SPGI platforms.
kpis.description: Kensho AI tool is integrated in Market Intelligence and Ratings to improve analytical workflows for clients.
kpis.signal: Generative AI APIs integrated in SPGI platforms (notably Kensho) support growing adoption by professional users.

kpis.name: Share of cloud contracts including AI
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include generative AI features.
kpis.description: SPGI integrates AI in its analytical workflows (ex: Kensho, AlphaSense) to enhance cloud solutions offered to clients.
kpis.signal: SPGI integrates AI in its analytical workflows, accelerating digital transformation for clients.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks due to its size, central role in global markets and responsibility as custodian of sensitive and confidential data. Cyber threats are evolving rapidly and becoming more sophisticated.

risks.title: Increased competition in data and analytics markets
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets changing rapidly to adapt to client needs. New entrants (notably in AI/ML) and existing competitors threaten differentiation.

ai_positioning.summary: SPGI actively integrates generative AI (notably Kensho AI) in its analytical workflows and data platforms. AI is used to enhance Market Intelligence, Ratings and Indices products. AI initiatives include R&D investments and increased capital spending for cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity, supporting client adoption of AI tools.
evidence: Continuous R&D investments in applied AI (8.5% of revenue)
Documented integration of Kensho AI in Market Intelligence and Ratings
Capex increase (+10%) for cloud infrastructure and security supporting AI
Explicit presence in 10-K Risk Factors of sections on 'Cybersecurity, Technology and Innovation Risks' supporting technological modernization
